item: Review findings of #1306, #1298 and #1308 fixed, and a light memory snapshot every 15 s near the guard's line
key_paths: src/api/unlock.py; src/scheduler/storage_guard.py; src/database/pool_watch.py; src/monitoring/session_hwm.py; src/monitoring/forensics.py; src/api/insights.py; tests/test_session_hwm_light.py; tests/test_storage_guard.py; tests/test_unlock_recovery_progress.py
summary: A queued second unlock re-asks the state inside the lock (no second verify, engine dispose or upkeep on an open app); is_disk_full classifies on the head of the text and the detail kept is the driver's first line, never the statement or its bound values; a reading older than a minute is not used to classify an I/O error while another read is in flight; the guard's failure key is per path; wording of the three PRs corrected (eleven tests in four files, split two and nine by measurement). New: a light pressure snapshot every 15 s while available memory is within 1.5 times the guard's floor, the process near its share, or the guard engaged (own ring of 8 and own file, the busiest threads by CPU since the previous one with stacks, blocks gained, its own cost; memory is not per thread, so the pairing is labelled an inference); the heavy cadence is unchanged. A test for each item, each mutant failing it.
